entry_type.description: The entry type that starts the agent when one is published.

agent.description: The agent that does the job (Settings → AI → Agents). It needs permission to save drafts: set Entries: author to Allow.

message.description: The job, in a sentence or two. The entry's title and link are added for you, along with a reminder to write the text itself and save it as a draft.
message.example: Draft a Bluesky post and a Mastodon post announcing it, each as its own draft.

playbooks.description: Published Playbooks to load in full for this job, on top of the agent's own (up to 3). Leave empty for none.
